correctness.rationale: The induced hyperspace map is continuous, surjective, and equivariant. A probability lift is obtained by finite-support approximation and compactness; Følner averaging then produces an invariant lift while preserving the invariant target pushforward. The generalized allowed class is respected because equivariance sends every compact central orbit segment to a compact central orbit segment with the same compact subset of the group. Pushing forward the source IC-rigidity support condition proves the target condition. The proof checks all quantifiers and uses no finite experiment.

Kra--Schmieding prove factor permanence only for the original discrete definition. The new proof checks the additional functorial point needed for the enlarged class and uses amenable invariant-measure lifting. Targeted statement-level searches and the current/prior own ledgers found no implication-equivalent generalized factor theorem.

value.rationale: Factor heredity is a natural permanence property for the new non-discrete version of IC-rigidity. Establishing it makes the recent flow examples stable under every compact-metric quotient and identifies the exact functorial compatibility of the orbit-segment class. This is a structural lemma with direct reuse in classification and factor analysis, rather than a renaming or arbitrary parameter slice.
